source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Identifying Vulnerabilities and Suspicious Activities under 9.2 as printed (PDF 128, printed 124).

blocks.text: Vulnerabilities are weaknesses in software, hardware, or user behavior that hackers can exploit. Suspicious activities may include unexpected system slowdowns, unknown programs running, or strange network traffic. Regularly checking system logs and using scanning tools can help find these warning signs. Recognizing patterns of unusual behavior allows users to take quick action. Identifying and fixing vulnerabilities early reduces the chance of successful attacks.
